description: This file contains functions and logic for creating language blocks in a curriculum, including handling user prompts, generating challenge files, updating JSON configurations, and managing curriculum structure for a coding education platform.

methods.name: createLanguageBlock
methods.description: Creates a new language challenge block, updates curriculum JSON files, and structures based on chapter/module hierarchy.

methods.name: updateIntroJson
methods.description: Updates the intro.json file with new block information, including chapter and module associations.

methods.name: createMetaJson
methods.description: Generates and writes metadata JSON for a new challenge block.

methods.name: createDialogueChallenge
methods.description: Creates a dialogue challenge file in the curriculum directory.

methods.name: createQuizChallenge
methods.description: Creates a quiz challenge file with specified question count.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file asynchronously.

methods.name: withTrace
methods.description: Wraps an async function to add error stack trace information.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Generates a prefix string for block naming based on superblock and block label.
